message.text:
I need to find where memo metadata is computed from content, what triggers recomputation, and what properties are extracted.

RebuildMemoPayload appears to be the mechanism that rebuilds memo payloads from content. I am tracing how it works in the codebase.

I will examine `ExtractAll` in `markdown.go` to identify the extracted properties, and check `CreateMemo` and `UpdateMemo` in `memo_service.go` to find the triggers.

I will also check whether mentions are stored in the memo payload or only used for notifications.

memopayload.RunOnce is not wired as a trigger in production.

CreateMemo and UpdateMemo trigger recomputation when content changes. CreateMemoComment also rebuilds because it calls CreateMemo internally. Tag renames may trigger recomputation too.

Derived metadata is stored in `memo.Payload` (protobuf `MemoPayload`), specifically the `Tags` and `Property` fields from `RebuildMemoPayload`.

Mentions are extracted separately by `ExtractAll` in `memo_mention_helpers.go` and are not persisted in the payload. The stored metadata includes `Tags` and `Property` fields such as `Title`, `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, and `HasIncompleteTasks`. The computation site is `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, which calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

Triggers include `CreateMemo` in `memo_service.go:108`, `UpdateMemo` when the content field is in the update mask in `memo_service.go:447`, and `CreateMemoComment` through `CreateMemo`. A batch rebuild via `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` exists but is not wired in production.

I have gathered enough information to fully answer the question.

Derived metadata lives in `memo.Payload` JSON as `MemoPayload`. Tags and properties are extracted from markdown content. Snippet generation is on-demand and separate from payload storage. `user_service_stats` consumes these fields for lists and previews.

h14.
**computation site:** `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`), which calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`); **triggers:** `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` when `content` is in the update mask (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`) — including comments created via `CreateMemoComment` → `CreateMemo`; **extracted properties:** `#tags` → `Payload.Tags`; content-derived `Payload.Property`: `Title` (first H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks`

The derived metadata lives in `store.Memo.Payload` (`store/memo.go`), persisted as JSON in the `payload` column. It is rebuilt from markdown content, not set directly by the user (unlike `Location`, which is applied separately in `CreateMemo` after rebuild).

**Computation:**

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	// ...
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

`ExtractAll` parses content with goldmark and walks the AST:

```376:405:internal/markdown/markdown.go
		if tagNode, ok := asMemoTagNode(n); ok {
			data.Tags = append(data.Tags, string(tagNode.Tag))
		}
		// ...
			if heading, ok := n.(*gast.Heading); ok && heading.Level == 1 {
				data.Property.Title = extractHeadingText(n, content)
			}
		// ...
		case gast.KindLink:
			data.Property.HasLink = true
		case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock, gast.KindCodeSpan:
			data.Property.HasCode = true
		case east.KindTaskCheckBox:
			data.Property.HasTaskList = true
			// ...
					data.Property.HasIncompleteTasks = true
```

**Triggers (production):**

| Operation | File | When |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` | Before `Store.CreateMemo` |
| `UpdateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` | Only when update mask includes `"content"` |

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` can batch-rebuild all memos (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27–71`), but that runner is not wired into server startup.

**Usage for lists/previews:** `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` exposes `Tags` and `Property` on API memos (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`); `user_service_stats.go` aggregates tag/property counts from stored payloads.

**Note:** `ExtractAll` also extracts `@mentions`, but `RebuildMemoPayload` does not persist them — mentions are handled separately at notification time via `memo_mention_helpers.go`. Snippets (`GenerateSnippet`) are computed on demand for webhooks, not stored in `Payload`.
